title.en: An Act Declaring September 28 of Every Year a Special Non-Working Holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Wenceslao Q. Vinzons, Sr., Patriot and Martyr
title.orig: An Act Declaring September 28 of Every Year a Special Non-Working Holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte to Commemorate the Birth Anniversary of Wenceslao Q. Vinzons, Sr., Patriot and Martyr

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1989/ra_6720_1989.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: In order to celebrate the birth anniversary of Wenceslao Q. Vinzons, Sr., September 28 of each year is hereby declared a special non-working holiday in the Province of Camarines Norte.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
